cases.sentence: Иди ко дворцу царя Иудеи и слушай слово Господне, царь Иудеи, сидящий на престоле ___.
cases.translation: Go to the palace of the king of Judah, king of Judah who sits on David's throne.
cases.explain: The possessive construction престол Давида (David's throne) requires genitive case.

cases.translation: Deliver the oppressed from the hands of the oppressor.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Если вы будете исполнять эти повеления, цари будут сидеть на престоле ___.
cases.translation: If you obey, kings will sit on the throne of David.
cases.explain: The same possessive construction престол Давида requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Если вы не будете исполнять эти повеления, то дворец превратится в ___.
cases.translation: If you disobey, this house will become a desolation.
cases.explain: The verb превратится (will become) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я пошлю к тебе разорителей, каждого с ___.
cases.translation: I will send destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) indicating accompaniment requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Люди будут проходить мимо этого города и спрашивать друг ___, за что Господь поступил так?
cases.translation: Many nations will pass by and ask each other, 'Why has Yahweh done this?'
cases.explain: The verb спрашивать (ask) with друг друга (each other) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Не плачьте об умершем и не скорбите о ___.
cases.translation: Don't weep for the dead, don't bemoan him.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Горе тому, кто не дает работникам ___ за их работу.
cases.translation: Woe to him who does not give workers payment for their work.
cases.explain: The verb дает (gives) is transitive and requires the accusative case.

reading.ru: Иди ко дворцу царя Иудеи и возвести там, слушай слово Господне, царь Иудеи, сидящий на престоле Давида.
reading.question: Where is Jeremiah commanded to go and deliver God's message?
options: To the palace of the king of Judah
reading.correct: To the palace of the king of Judah
reading.explain: God tells Jeremiah: 'Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there.'

reading.ru: Делайте то, что справедливо и праведно, помогайте обездоленному спастись от рук притеснителя, не обижайте и не притесняйте чужеземцев, сирот и вдов, и не проливайте в этом краю невинной крови.
reading.question: What is God's command regarding justice and treatment of vulnerable people?
options: Execute justice, rescue the oppressed, protect foreigners, orphans, and widows, and don't shed innocent blood
reading.correct: Execute justice, rescue the oppressed, protect foreigners, orphans, and widows, and don't shed innocent blood
reading.explain: The text explicitly commands: 'Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed...Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.'

reading.ru: Если вы будете точно исполнять эти повеления, то через ворота этого дворца на колесницах и на конях будут въезжать цари, которые сидят на престоле Давида.
reading.question: What blessing does God promise if the people obey His commands?
options: Kings will enter the palace on chariots and horses, sitting on David's throne
The kingdom will expand to all nations
They will become wealthy beyond measure
reading.correct: Kings will enter the palace on chariots and horses, sitting on David's throne
reading.explain: God says: 'For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David's throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses.'

reading.ru: Но если вы не будете исполнять эти повеления, возвещает Господь, то, клянусь собой, этот дворец превратится в руины.
reading.question: What consequence awaits if the people do not obey?
options: The palace will become a desolation
They will serve the king well
reading.correct: The palace will become a desolation
reading.explain: God says: 'But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself, that this house will become a desolation.'

reading.ru: Вспомни своего отца. Он и ел, и пил, но делал то, что правильно и справедливо, и поэтому жил в благополучии.
reading.question: What example does God give from the previous king's reign?
options: He ate and drank but did what was right and just, and therefore prospered
reading.correct: He ate and drank but did what was right and just, and therefore prospered
reading.explain: God recalls: 'Your father ate and drank, and did justice and righteousness. Then it was well with him.'

reading.ru: Но твои глаза и твое сердце хотят лишь наживы, хотят проливать невинную кровь, угнетать, вымогать.
reading.question: What are the accusations against the current king's character?
options: His eyes and heart desire only gain, innocent blood, oppression, and extortion
His desire is to serve justly
His intention is to honor his father
His goal is to protect the kingdom
reading.correct: His eyes and heart desire only gain, innocent blood, oppression, and extortion
reading.explain: The text states: 'But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence.'
